WITH matched AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT sc.zoneref, s.healtheval
  FROM scanconservation sc
  INNER JOIN sites s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
),
status_counts AS (
  SELECT healtheval, COUNT(*) as site_count
  FROM matched
  GROUP BY healtheval
),
stats AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(site_count) as total,
    COUNT(*) as num_statuses
  FROM status_counts
),
with_share_and_threshold AS (
  SELECT
    sc.healtheval,
    sc.site_count,
    CAST(sc.site_count AS REAL) / s.total as share,
    1.0 / s.num_statuses as avg_threshold
  FROM status_counts sc
  CROSS JOIN stats s
),
filtered AS (
  SELECT healtheval, site_count, share, avg_threshold
  FROM with_share_and_threshold
  WHERE share > avg_threshold
)
SELECT
  AVG(site_count) as avg_count,
  AVG(share) as avg_share,
  AVG(share - avg_threshold) as avg_excess
FROM filtered
